# outputs/mhw/top_events/

Top-10 longest and strongest MHW events per region.

## Contents

`top10_longest_{region}.csv`, `top10_strongest_{region}.csv` for north / central / south.

## Generated by

`src/climate/scripts/generate_mhw_reports.py`.

## Upstream / Downstream

Catalogue → rankings → `outputs/top_event_sst_maps/`, publication triptychs (`outputs/publication/figures/07_top5_triptychs/`).

## Notes

Project records: longest South 81 d (2024-06-14); strongest South 0.943 °C (2024-04-14).
